content: Fixed-asset register (FAR) column conventions across templates (AssetPrime, MapTrack, Kladana, FMX, Zoho): Identification (asset ID/tag, name, category/type, serial number), Assignment (custodian/owner, department, location), Financial (purchase date, purchase cost, current/book value), Warranty (start/expiry), Status (condition, disposal date). Minimum viable per Kladana: asset ID, name/category, acquisition date, cost. Depreciation columns are enterprise accounting territory, optional for internal tools.
